name: THSV StreamBridge - Live Beacon
author: surakage
description: Delivers one broker-authorized Live Beacon message to a creator-owned Discord channel or forum webhook.
triggerSafety: Deliver must remain triggerless and requires a one-use broker token. The webhook secret stays in its Set Argument and is never returned, logged, or sent to StreamBridge.
verificationStatus: Streamer.bot channel delivery and Discord Execute Webhook forum thread_name contracts are source-verified; each creator must live-test their private webhook.
